Definition: from a compound of G575 and G1651; refutation, i.e. (by implication) contempt:--nought.
BiblicalUsage: Contempt, or coming to nothing — Demetrius warning that Paul's preaching would bring the temple of Artemis into disrepute, and his whole craft into contempt. The word measures what people fear losing when the gospel arrives.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gospel still threatens every idol's reputation, and that is a sign it is working.
